description: Complete compact resolution JSON, at most 32768 UTF-8 bytes including keys, punctuation, escapes and whitespace. Keep all necessary diagnosis and repair steps concise; never truncate. Per-field patterns bound characters; the application additionally enforces UTF-8 byte budgets and nonblank strings.

summary.description: Nonblank root cause summary, 1–2000 UTF-8 bytes, no NUL. Do not repeat supplied code or logs.

items.description: Nonblank actionable repair step, 1–2000 UTF-8 bytes, no NUL. Preserve all required work while keeping the whole report below 32768 bytes.
Nonblank necessary assumption, 1–1000 UTF-8 bytes, no NUL. Use an empty array when none is needed.

external_action.description: Null when agents can proceed; otherwise a nonblank specific owner-only action or unavailable prerequisite, 1–500 UTF-8 bytes, no NUL.
